name: Spain — employment (Régimen General, territorio común)

changelog.summary: Sick and birth leave paid through a leave pay rule are refused like unpaid leave: temporary incapacity contributes on the previous month's base and birth leave on the base of the month before that (Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 6), unpaid days on the minimum base (art. 7); the refusal now names them. Before, a fully paid sick day was calculated as an ordinary month.

Descendants and ascendants with a disability (LIRPF art. 60.2), court-ordered spousal pension and child maintenance (RIRPF arts. 83.3, 85.2), residents of Ceuta, Melilla and La Palma working there (RIRPF arts. 80.2, 86.2) and training contracts paid at the minimum base (Orden art. 46 fixed quotas); before, all of them were refused. The withholding rate is regularized automatically when the data change during the year (RIRPF art. 87.3 with the limits of art. 87.5, from the determination kept with each result); before, the run was refused until the regularized rate was entered.

Irregular income: the annual pay may include income generated over more than two years or notoriously irregular (irregularIncomeAmount); the withholding rate's base is reduced by 30% of it, up to 300,000 EUR of income (LIRPF art. 18.2, RIRPF art. 83.3.a), as the AEAT algorithm's IRREGULAR1. Before, irregularIncome was refused.

The month's ordinary pay for the contribution bases is the social earnings less the part of the extra payments and overtime that is itself in them. Before, a Bonus component not marked subject to social contributions was subtracted twice, which could leave a month with an extra pay without common-contingency contributions.

2026: IRPF withholding rate per the AEAT algorithm (RIRPF arts. 81-86) with a year-to-date check that asks for the regularized rate; social security per Orden PJC/297/2026: common contingencies 28.30%, MEI 0.90%, unemployment 7.05% / 8.30%, FOGASA 0.20%, vocational training 0.70%, AT/EP from the tariff, solidarity contribution above 5,101.20, overtime in the AT/EP base with its 28.30% / 14% additional contribution, the LGSS art. 152 exemption past retirement age (IT 1.55% only). Withholding rates checked against the AEAT calculation service.

employee.description: Where the withholding belongs: COMMON for work performed in the common territory; CEUTA_MELILLA_LA_PALMA for an employee resident in Ceuta, Melilla or La Palma whose work income is obtained there, withheld at the rate reduced by 60% (RIRPF art. 80.2; DA 57ª LIRPF for La Palma) — a resident working elsewhere is COMMON. Work performed in the Basque Country or Navarre is withheld under the foral rules (Concierto art. 7.Uno.a; Convenio art. 10.1.a) and is refused

Expected gross pay from this employer in 2026 (RETRIB, RIRPF art. 83.2): fixed and foreseeable variable pay, in cash and in kind, without arrears belonging to earlier years. For a contract renewed in the year, include what was paid earlier in the year

Annual amount of the extra payments and other pay accruing over periods longer than a month (pagas extraordinarias), prorated over 12 months in the social security base (LGSS art. 147; Orden art. 1). Pay them as BONUS

Expected employee social security contributions for the year (COTIZACIONES, RIRPF art. 83.2.a). Without it the template estimates 12 months of contributions on annualPay / 12; required for part-time employees

Family situation from the employee's modelo 145 (RIRPF art. 81.1): 1 single, widowed, divorced or separated with descendants and the single-parent joint-filing reduction; 2 married with a spouse earning no more than 1,500 EUR a year; 3 any other (and when not stated)

Children and other descendants giving right to the minimum (LIRPF art. 58): under 25 at the end of 2026 (born 2002 or later), or of any age with a disability, living with the employee, earning no more than 8,000 EUR and not filing a return with more than 1,800 EUR (LIRPF art. 61.2.ª). Children receiving court-ordered maintenance from the employee do not count (RIRPF art. 85.2)
Of those descendants, the ones born in 2024 or later, or adopted or fostered in 2024 or later (+2,800 each, LIRPF art. 58.2)

How the descendants count, from modelo 145 (required with descendants): HALF unless the employee alone is entitled to their whole minimum (RIRPF art. 84.2; LIRPF art. 61.1.ª); all of them are taken the same way

Parents or other ascendants aged 65 to 74 in 2026 (born 1952 to 1961) living with the employee at least half the year, earning no more than 8,000 EUR and not filing a return with more than 1,800 EUR (LIRPF arts. 59, 61.2.ª)
Ascendants aged 75 or more in 2026 (born 1951 or earlier), same conditions (+1,400 each, LIRPF art. 59.2)
Ascendants under 65 in 2026 with a disability of 33% or more, same conditions; they give right to the ascendant minimum (LIRPF art. 59.1) and are counted again in ascendantsDisability*
Number of descendants (the employee included) the ascendants live with, who share their minimum (LIRPF art. 61.1.ª); the same for all of them
Of the descendants, those with a disability from 33% to under 65% without reduced mobility or need of help (+3,000 each, LIRPF art. 60.2)
Of the descendants, those with a disability from 33% to under 65% with reduced mobility or needing help from another person (+3,000 and +3,000 assistance each)
Of the descendants, those with a disability of 65% or more (+9,000 and +3,000 assistance each)
Of the ascendants counted (65 to 74, 75 or more, disabled under 65), those with a disability from 33% to under 65% without reduced mobility (+3,000 each, shared like their minimum)
Of the ascendants counted, those with a disability from 33% to under 65% with reduced mobility or needing help (+3,000 and +3,000 assistance each, shared)
Of the ascendants counted, those with a disability of 65% or more (+9,000 and +3,000 assistance each, shared)
The employee's own disability: 33% to 65%, the same with reduced mobility or needing help from another person, or 65% or more (LIRPF art. 60; RIRPF art. 83.2.b)
The employee, registered unemployed, accepted a job requiring a change of residence (+2,000 EUR expenses this year and next, RIRPF art. 83.2.b)
The employee stated in modelo 145 loan payments for a main home bought before 2013 giving right to the transitional deduction; only with annual pay under 33,007.20 (RIRPF art. 86.1)

For the minimum rate (RIRPF art. 86.2): GENERAL (also special relationships of people with disabilities in special employment centres and of inmates), UNDER_ONE_YEAR (contracts under a year and artists, minimum 2%), SPECIAL_RELATIONSHIP (other special dependent relationships, minimum 15%), DAILY_MANUAL (sporadic manual work paid by the day — refused)
Withholding rate in percent with two decimals replacing the computed one, with its reason

REGULARIZED: a rate the employer regularized under RIRPF art. 87 (used as entered and carried on; needed only where the template doesn't regularize: housing-loan reduction, moving into or out of Ceuta, Melilla or La Palma, or no kept determination yet); REQUESTED_HIGHER: a higher rate the employee asked for in writing (RIRPF art. 88.5; used when above the computed one)

Year the brought-forward figures belong to (pay with you this year before the first payroll in Humano); other years' figures are ignored. Needed to regularize the rate when earlier months are not in Humano
Months paid by you this year before the first payroll in Humano
Work income paid by you this year before the first payroll in Humano (retribuciones satisfechas)
IRPF withheld by you on it (retenciones practicadas)
Social security contribution group (grupo de cotización) of the employee's professional category, 1 to 7 (Orden art. 3); groups 8 to 11 contribute by day and are refused

Unemployment rate (Orden art. 33.2.a): INDEFINITE 7.05% for open-ended contracts (also part-time, fijos discontinuos, training, relief, substitution and interim contracts, and any contract with a worker with a disability of 33% or more); FIXED_TERM 8.30% for other fixed-term contracts
Part-time contract: hours actually worked this month; the minimum bases are hours x the hourly minimum of the group, and x 8.58 for AT/EP (Orden arts. 38-39)
The overtime (OT) paid is for preventing or repairing extraordinary and urgent damage (ET art. 35.3): additional contribution 14% instead of 28.30% (Orden art. 5)
This employee's AT/EP rate where the tariff sets it by occupation (DA 61ª LGSS, cuadro II), replacing the employer's rate

PAST_RETIREMENT_AGE: the employee has reached the ordinary retirement age of LGSS art. 205.1.a) and does not work for a public administration — exempt from common contingencies except IT, unemployment, FOGASA and vocational training (LGSS art. 152); WORKING_PENSIONER: draws a retirement pension compatible with the work (art. 153, 9% solidarity) — not supported

Training contract (formación en alternancia, or a remaining contrato para la formación y el aprendizaje): fixed monthly quotas of Orden art. 46 while the common-contingencies base does not exceed the minimum base; full-time, groups 4 to 7, no overtime
The employee also works for another company (pluriempleo), sharing the maximum base (Orden art. 10) — not supported
A descendant or ascendant has a disability (LIRPF art. 60.2): enter them in descendantsDisability* / ascendantsDisability*
The employee pays a court-ordered compensatory pension to a spouse or maintenance to children: enter spousalPension and/or childMaintenance
Compensatory pension to the spouse fixed by court order, annual amount (reduces the base, RIRPF art. 83.3; algorithm CONYUGE)

Maintenance for children fixed by court order, annual amount (anualidades por alimentos, RIRPF art. 85.2): when below the base, the scale applies separately to it and to the rest, and the minimum is increased by 1,980; those children do not count as descendants
The annual pay includes income with the 30% reduction (LIRPF art. 18.2): set irregularIncomeAmount

Part of annualPay with the 30% reduction of LIRPF art. 18.2, imputed in this single year: income generated over more than two years (for termination pay, the years of service), unless you applied the reduction to such income of this employee in the five previous years (RIRPF art. 83.3.a), or income notoriously irregular in time (RIRPF art. 12.1: relocation pay above the exempt amounts, payments for termination by mutual agreement, non-exempt literary, artistic or scientific prizes, ...). Paid in instalments only within RIRPF art. 12.2. At most 700,000

minimumBases.description: Minimum common-contingencies bases by contribution group: monthly (Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 3) and per hour for part-time contracts (art. 39)

exemptLimits.description: Annual pay up to which no withholding applies, by family situation and number of descendants (RIRPF art. 81.1, RD 142/2024; algorithm TABLA 1); situation 1 needs a descendant

withholdingScale.description: Withholding scale (LIRPF art. 101.1; algorithm TABLA 2) with the published cumulative quotas

solidarity.description: Solidarity contribution on monthly remuneration above the maximum base, employee and employer shares (Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 17; LGSS art. 19 bis)

steps.message: Spanish payroll is monthly: the pay period must be a whole calendar month
The payment must fall in the same year as the pay period: withholding follows the payment (RIRPF art. 78) and contributions the month of accrual, so pay made in another year is not supported
Pre-tax deductions are not supported by this template

Unpaid, sick and birth leave are not supported: days registered without pay contribute on the minimum base (Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 7), and temporary incapacity and birth leave contribute on the base of an earlier month (art. 6)
The employee must be employed for the whole month: bases for a month started or ended part-way are prorated by days, which this template does not do
Withholding on work performed in the Basque Country or Navarre follows the foral rules (Concierto Económico art. 7.Uno.a; Convenio Económico art. 10.1.a), which this template does not do
Manual workers paid by the daily wage (peonadas) are not supported: their annual pay is 100 x the daily wage (RIRPF art. 83.2)
Training contracts are supported full-time in contribution groups 4 to 7, without overtime, with unemploymentRate INDEFINITE (Orden PJC/297/2026 arts. 33.2.a.1.º, 46)
Employees drawing a retirement pension compatible with the work contribute under LGSS art. 153 (IT, AT/EP and a 9% solidarity contribution), which this template does not do
For an employee past retirement age (LGSS art. 152), pay above the maximum base (solidarity contribution) or overtime is not supported
Employees in multiple employment (pluriempleo) share the maximum base between companies (Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 10), which this template does not do
A descendant or ascendant has a disability: enter how many in descendantsDisability33, descendantsDisability33Mobility, descendantsDisability65 or the ascendant equivalents (LIRPF art. 60.2)
Descendants with a disability are counted among the descendants, so there cannot be more of them
Ascendants with a disability are counted among the ascendants (65 to 74, 75 or more, disabled under 65), and each disabled one under 65 has a disability grade
The employee pays court-ordered amounts: enter the annual spousalPension and/or childMaintenance (RIRPF arts. 83.3, 85.2)
The annual pay includes irregular income: enter irregularIncomeAmount, the part of annualPay with the 30% reduction (LIRPF art. 18.2; RIRPF art. 83.3.a)
irregularIncomeAmount is part of annualPay, so it cannot be larger
Irregular income above 700,000 EUR is not supported: for termination pay the income with the reduction falls from 300,000 EUR to zero at 1,000,000 EUR (LIRPF art. 18.2)
Contribution groups 8 to 11 contribute on daily bases (Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 3), which this template does not do
Overtime paid without ordinary pay in the same run is not supported: the contribution bases start from the month's ordinary pay
Part-time employee: set the employee's partTimeHours (hours worked this month) for the hourly minimum bases (Orden PJC/297/2026 arts. 38-39)
Part-time employee: set the employee's annualSocialContributions; the template's estimate assumes full-time bases
Extra payments (BONUS) are prorated over the year in the contribution base (LGSS art. 147): set the employee's annualExtraPay
Family situation 1 requires at least one descendant (RIRPF art. 81.1)
descendantsUnder3 counts descendants already included in descendants, so it cannot be larger
Set the employee's descendantsComputation: descendants count by half unless the employee alone is entitled to their whole minimum (RIRPF art. 84.2)
The housing loan reduction applies only with annual pay under 33,007.20 EUR (RIRPF art. 86.1)
Set withholdingRateOverride together with withholdingRateOverrideReason (REGULARIZED or REQUESTED_HIGHER), or neither

steps.message: The withholding data changed and the housing-loan reduction is or was applied, whose regularization (RIRPF art. 87.3.b) this template does not do: regularize the rate and enter it as withholdingRateOverride with reason REGULARIZED

The employee moved into or out of the Ceuta, Melilla and La Palma regime during the year, whose regularization (RIRPF art. 87.2.9.º) this template does not do: regularize the rate and enter it as withholdingRateOverride with reason REGULARIZED
annualPay must include what was already paid this year and be larger than it: the regularized rate applies to the pay still to come (RIRPF art. 87.3.c)

The withholding data changed, and regularizing the rate needs everything paid and withheld this year (RIRPF art. 87.3.b), but not every earlier month with you is in a posted payroll: set broughtForwardYear and the brought-forward pay and withholding for the months before Humano

steps.expr: (#withholdingBase != #ytd.last('withholdingBase') or #personalFamilyMinimum != #ytd.last('personalFamilyMinimum') or (#employee['spousalPension'] > 0 and #spousalPensionDetermined != #ytd.last('spousalPensionDetermined')) or (#employee['childMaintenance'] > 0 and #childMaintenanceDetermined != #ytd.last('childMaintenanceDetermined'))) and !(#ytd.last('familySituationCode') == 2 and #familySituationCode == 3)

steps.message: The withholding rate computed from the current data differs from the rate applied earlier this year: regularize it under RIRPF art. 87 and enter the regularized rate as withholdingRateOverride with reason REGULARIZED

Training contract paid above the minimum base: Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 46 adds contributions on the excess, and its third rule leaves open whether the MEI then uses the actual or the minimum base, so this template refuses it

steps.label: Wage Guarantee Fund, training contract (Orden art. 46)
Temporary incapacity past retirement age (IT, art. 152 LGSS)

limitations: Common tax territory, Régimen General employees paid monthly in EUR in 2026, for whole months with the payment in the same year. Work performed in the Basque Country or Navarre, contribution groups 8 to 11, multiple employment, part months, unpaid leave and working pensioners (LGSS art. 153) are refused. Employees past the ordinary retirement age contribute only IT (1.30% / 0.25%) and AT/EP (LGSS art. 152; Orden art. 32.1.a), not when paid above the maximum base or overtime. Overtime (OT) enters only the AT/EP base and carries the additional contribution of Orden art. 5 (28.30%, or 14% for force majeure); it must be paid with ordinary pay in the same run.

Residents of Ceuta, Melilla or La Palma whose work income is obtained there (taxTerritory CEUTA_MELILLA_LA_PALMA) are withheld at the rate reduced by 60%, with minimums of 0.8% and 6% (RIRPF arts. 80.2, 86.2; DA 57ª LIRPF); the contribution reductions for Ceuta and Melilla are not applied.

Training contracts (formación en alternancia and remaining contratos para la formación y el aprendizaje) pay the fixed quotas of Orden art. 46 while the common-contingencies base does not exceed the minimum base, full-time in groups 4 to 7 without overtime; above the minimum base they are refused, as the Orden's third rule leaves open which base the MEI uses then.

The withholding rate comes from the annual figures entered (annual pay, contributions, family data from modelo 145) and applies to the whole payment. Each result keeps the determination (rate, annual withholding, base, minimum and the data they came from); while nothing changes the kept rate carries on, and when the data change the rate is regularized (RIRPF art. 87.3) from the pay and withholding so far, within the limits of art. 87.5 for changes in the base, the minimum, a spousal pension or child maintenance (as the AEAT algorithm's causes 1 to 4). Not automated, so refused until the employer enters the rate as withholdingRateOverride REGULARIZED: changes while a housing-loan reduction is or was applied, moving into or out of the Ceuta, Melilla and La Palma regime, and data changed in months posted before version 2026.1.3 (no kept determination). Earlier months not in Humano need the brought-forward pay and withholding. A higher rate requested under art. 88.5 can be entered as REQUESTED_HIGHER. Regularization starts in the first run after the data change; the quarterly option of art. 87.4 is not offered.
Without annualSocialContributions the expected employee contributions are estimated as 12 months on annualPay / 12 at full-time bases.

Dependants with a disability are counted by grade (all descendants by whole or all by half, all ascendants shared the same way); children receiving court-ordered maintenance must not be entered as descendants.

Not modelled: irregular income above 700,000 EUR, pensioners and the unemployed, pay in kind and its ingreso a cuenta, arrears of earlier years (15% fixed rate), fixed rates (directors, courses, authors), the special regime for workers posted to Spain, sick leave and birth leave months (their own bases), contribution reductions and incentives, and the 33.62 EUR charge at the end of fixed-term contracts under 30 days (Orden art. 28).
Extra payments (BONUS) are prorated over the year in the contribution base from annualExtraPay (Orden art. 1, monthly-paid employees); a run holding only BONUS pays withholding but no contributions.
Contributions are rounded to the cent, half up, per line; part-time minimum bases (hours x hourly base) and the extra-pay proration to the cent, half up.

Status LAW_DERIVED: values are cited from the BOE consolidated texts, the Orden PJC/297/2026 and the AEAT 2026 algorithm and help; the cases are derived from them (one reproduces the AEAT help's 15.96% example) and every case's withholding rate, regularized rates included, matches the AEAT calculation service.
